header: Fine-grained access control in Amazon OpenSearch Service
content:
Fine-grained access control oﬀers additional ways of controlling access to your data on Amazon
OpenSearch Service. For example, depending on who makes the request, you might want a search
to return results from only one index. You might want to hide certain ﬁelds in your documents or
exclude certain documents altogether.
Fine-grained access control oﬀers the following beneﬁts:
